notes: DJI D-Log M drone clip, Nov 12 2026 17:29: sunset over a lake. Streaky pink/orange clouds, blue sky above, mountains in silhouette, a dark neighborhood and fields in front; the drone turns toward the sun, whose glow grows from 16% to 36% of the picture by 30 s. Own look from its hues (red 30-45, orange 45-60, blue 240-255). The measured white point (0.871, 99.7th percentile) clipped the sun glow to a white blob and halved its color, so levels.white 0.96 (near the brightest raw value) and a curve shoulder that keeps the sun core at its raw brightness (OKLab L ~0.90, where gold h~72 can still hold color 0.08; at 0.93 only 0.057). Gold band 72 x1.15; red-orange 38 eased x0.92 (the lake reflection doubled to color 0.10 and read flat orange); blue 240 x1.15, natural. Log footage: saturation 1.3, vibrance 0.5. No people: no skin guard. Foreground left dark (silhouette at sunset; darker and clean). Camera exposure steady (+0.04 at most): no time keys. Toe eased a touch ([0.02,0.017],[0.05,0.045]): the 4K test had 8% of the picture crushed to black in the fields at 27-31 s; this keeps a hint of them for ~4% more grain.
